liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **banter - inviting Bowlive horns**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **The Swamp**: back after 25 archived shows (373 days); rare: 6 archived performances [5]
- **Bewildered**: rare: 11 archived performances [5]
- **DJ Logic/intro**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Give Me A Sign *$**: rare: 5 archived performances [5]
- **Never Gonna Let You Go *$**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Leave Me Alone *$*%^&**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Baby I Do Love You @*%^&**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]

## The recordings

- **soulive2013-03-09.mk5.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 141 min [1]
- **soulive2013-03-09.mk5.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 141 min [2]. Said about its sound: Distortion from a nearby stage monitor affected the opening act's recording but is absent from the Soulive sets [2]
- **soulive2013-03-09.mk21-mk8ms.flac24**: audience recording; 20 songs; 141 min [3]
- **soulive2013-03-09.mk21-mk8ms.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 141 min [4]

## Around the show

- Part of Bowlive IV, night 3; the Alecia Chakour Band opened the evening [1]
- Guests included Bowlive Horns (James Casey on tenor sax, Igmar Thomas on trumpet), Nigel Hall, Alecia Chakour, DJ Logic, Adam Smirnoff, Ron Johnson and Nikki Glaspie [1]
- Guest information, especially for set 2, may not be entirely accurate; Alecia Chakour Band opened on Bowlive IV night 3 [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **soulive2013-03-09.mk5.flac24**: taped by Eric McRoberts; transferred by Eric McRoberts; source: Audience/On Stage [1]. Also: This is the 24-bit version of the recording, labelled mk5; a 16-bit version exists separately [1]
- **soulive2013-03-09.mk5.flac16**: taped by Eric McRoberts; transferred by Eric McRoberts; source: Audience/On Stage [2]. Also: A higher quality 24-bit version of this recording exists; this one is the 16-bit mk5 FLAC [2]
- **soulive2013-03-09.mk21-mk8ms.flac24**: taped by Eric McRoberts; transferred by Eric McRoberts; source: Audience/On Stage [3]
- **soulive2013-03-09.mk21-mk8ms.flac16**: taped by Eric McRoberts; transferred by Eric McRoberts; source: Audience/On Stage [4]
